Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines at **185 seats**, effective 2025-09-01 (executed 2025-08-19). The account record also shows 185 active seats.

For the QBR, note that Amendment No. 3 (executed 2026-09-22) raises the count to **230 seats**, effective 2027-01-01. Amendment No. 1 is the 185 figure, and it was superseded by No. 3 only from that later date.
